last.verdict: Investors cheered another sales forecast hike and the fastest base-business growth in over a decade.

reasons.label: Sales outlook raised again
reasons.text: Full-year product sales now seen at $31.0-31.3 billion, up from $30.1-30.4 billion.

reasons.label: HIV growth surged
reasons.text: HIV sales rose 18% to $6.2 billion, with prevention sales nearly doubling.

reasons.label: Higher profit margins
reasons.text: Adjusted product margin rose to 88.1% from 86.5% as a royalty obligation expired.

story: Gilead has raised its sales outlook two quarters running, led by HIV, while big deal charges keep full-year results in the red. The stock slipped last quarter despite the raise, but is rising now on stronger growth.

history.verdict: Shares slipped despite a raised sales outlook, as huge deal charges and a trial failure weighed.

reasons.label: Huge deal-driven loss
reasons.text: Acquired research charges of $11.2 billion pushed the quarter to an $8.45 per-share loss.

reasons.label: Lung cancer trial stopped
reasons.text: Gilead and Merck ended the Phase 3 EVOKE-03 study of Trodelvy in lung cancer.

reasons.label: Cell therapy shrinking
reasons.text: Cell therapy sales fell 14% to $417 million on competition, offsetting HIV growth of 12%.
